verses.arabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
verses.english: By the scattering [winds] that scatter [the clouds];
verses.transliteration_html: Waalththariyati tharwan
verses.transliteration_text: Waalththariyati tharwan

verses.arabic: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
verses.english: by the [rain] bearing [clouds] laden [with water];
verses.transliteration_html: Faalhamilati wiqran
verses.transliteration_text: Faalhamilati wiqran

verses.arabic: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
verses.english: by [the ships] which move gently [on the sea];
verses.transliteration_html: Faaljariyati yusran
verses.transliteration_text: Faaljariyati yusran

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.english: by [the angels] who dispense [livelihood] by [His] command:
verses.transliteration_html: Faalmuqassimati amran
verses.transliteration_text: Faalmuqassimati amran

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
verses.english: indeed what you are promised is true,
verses.transliteration_html: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun
verses.transliteration_text: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.english: and indeed the retribution will surely come to pass!
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.english: By the sky full of adornment [with stars],
verses.transliteration_html: Waalssamai thati alhubuki
verses.transliteration_text: Waalssamai thati alhubuki

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
verses.english: indeed you are of different opinions!
verses.transliteration_html: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin
verses.transliteration_text: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin

verses.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.english: He who has been turned away [from the truth] is turned away from it.
verses.transliteration_html: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika
verses.transliteration_text: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.english: Perish the liars,
verses.transliteration_html: Qutila alkharrasoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qutila alkharrasoona

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
verses.english: who are heedless in a stupor!
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.english: They ask, ‘When will be the Day of Retribution?’
verses.transliteration_html: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.english: It is the day when they will be tormented in the Fire,
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona

verses.arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.english: [and will be told]: ‘Taste your torment. This is what you used to hasten.’
verses.transliteration_html: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.english: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.english: receiving what their Lord has given them, for they had been virtuous aforetime.
verses.transliteration_html: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena
verses.transliteration_text: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena

verses.arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.english: They used to sleep a little during the night,
verses.transliteration_html: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.english: and at dawns they would plead for forgiveness,
verses.transliteration_html: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.english: and there was a share in their wealth for the beggar and the deprived.
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.english: In the earth are signs for those who have conviction,
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.english: and in your souls [as well]. Will you not then perceive?
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: And in the sky is your provision and what you are promised.
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.english: By the Lord of the sky and the earth, it is indeed the truth, just as [it is a fact that] you speak.
verses.transliteration_html: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.english: Did you receive the story of Abraham’s honoured guests?
verses.transliteration_html: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena
verses.transliteration_text: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.english: When they entered into his presence, they said, ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’ He answered, ‘[You are] an unfamiliar folk.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
verses.english: Then he retired to his family and brought a fat [roasted] calf,
verses.transliteration_html: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin
verses.transliteration_text: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin

verses.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.english: and put it near them. He said, ‘Will you not eat?’
verses.transliteration_html: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona
verses.transliteration_text: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.english: Then he felt a fear of them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid!’ and they gave him the good news of a wise son.
verses.transliteration_html: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin
verses.transliteration_text: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
verses.english: Then his wife came forward crying [with joy]. She beat her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman!’
verses.transliteration_html: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: They said, ‘So has your Lord said. Indeed He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘O messengers, what is now your errand?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘We have been sent toward a guilty people,
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

verses.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.english: that We may rain upon them stones of clay,
verses.transliteration_html: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin
verses.transliteration_text: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin

verses.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.english: sent for the transgressors from your Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena
verses.transliteration_text: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: So We picked out those who were in it of the faithful,
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena

verses.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.english: but We did not find there other than one house of Muslims,
verses.transliteration_html: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.english: and We have left therein a sign for those who fear a painful punishment.’
verses.transliteration_html: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema
verses.transliteration_text: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema

verses.arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: And in Moses [too there is a sign] when We sent him to Pharaoh with a manifest authority.
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.english: But he turned away assured of his might, and said, ‘A magician or a crazy man!’
verses.transliteration_html: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun
verses.transliteration_text: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea, while he was blameworthy.
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun

verses.arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.english: And in ‘Ad when We unleashed upon them a barren wind.
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema

verses.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.english: It left nothing that it came upon without making it like decayed bones.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi
verses.transliteration_text: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi

verses.arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.english: And in Thamud, when they were told, ‘Enjoy for a while.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin
verses.transliteration_text: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin

verses.arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.english: Then they defied the command of their Lord; so the thunderbolt seized them as they looked on.
verses.transliteration_html: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona
verses.transliteration_text: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona

verses.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.english: So they were neither able to rise up, nor to come to one another’s aid.
verses.transliteration_html: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena
verses.transliteration_text: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.english: And the people of Noah aforetime. Indeed, they were a transgressing lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.english: We have built the heaven with might, and indeed it is We who are its expanders.
verses.transliteration_html: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.english: And We have spread out the earth, so how excellent spreaders We have been!
verses.transliteration_html: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona

verses.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.english: In all things We have created pairs so that you may take admonition.
verses.transliteration_html: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: ‘So flee toward Allah. Indeed, I am from Him a manifest warner to you.
verses.transliteration_html: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: Do not set up another god besides Allah. Indeed I am from Him a manifest warner to you.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.english: So it was that there did not come any apostle to those who were before them but they said, ‘A magician,’ or ‘A crazy man!’
verses.transliteration_html: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun
verses.transliteration_text: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun

verses.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.english: Did they enjoin this upon one another?! Rather, they were a rebellious lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona
verses.transliteration_text: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
verses.english: So turn away from them, as you will not be blameworthy.
verses.transliteration_html: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin
verses.transliteration_text: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin

verses.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: And admonish, for admonition indeed benefits the faithful.
verses.transliteration_html: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.english: I did not create the jinn and the humans except that they may worship Me.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni
verses.transliteration_text: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni

verses.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.english: I desire no provision from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni
verses.transliteration_text: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.english: Indeed it is Allah who is the All-provider, Powerful and All-strong.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu
verses.transliteration_text: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.english: Indeed the lot of those who do wrong [now] will be like the lot of their [earlier] counterparts. So let them not ask Me to hasten on [that fate].
verses.transliteration_html: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: Woe to the faithless for the day they are promised!
verses.transliteration_html: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
